mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages (room_id, sender_id, sender_type, content, msg_type, attach_url, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{senderType}, #{content}, #{msgType}, #{attachUrl}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, room_id as roomId, sender_id as senderId, sender_type as senderType, content, msg_type as msgType, attach_url as attachUrl, created_at as createdAt FROM chat_messages WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT cmr.room_id as roomId, cr.room_name as roomName, cr.order_id as orderId, cr.room_type as roomType, (SELECT content FROM chat_messages WHERE room_id = cmr.room_id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) as lastMsg, (SELECT created_at FROM chat_messages WHERE room_id = cmr.room_id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) as time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message_read WHERE room_id = cmr.room_id AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0) as unreadCount FROM chat_room_member cmr LEFT JOIN chat_room cr ON cmr.room_id = cr.room_id WHERE cmr.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY time DESC
SELECT id, room_id as roomId, user_id as userId, user_type as userType, join_time as joinTime FROM chat_room_member WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
SELECT id, room_id as roomId, user_id as userId, user_type as userType, join_time as joinTime FROM chat_room_member WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND user_id != #{senderId}
